title: Palindrome pairs count
statementMd:
Count index pairs `i < j` such that `words[i] + words[j]` or `words[j] + words[i]` is a palindrome (count the pair once if either holds).

**Example:** `count_palindrome_pairs(["abcd", "dcba", "lls", "s", "sssll"])` returns `3`.
hints: Brute force over pairs with a palindrome test.
